name: rear-hand cross punch
rules: The character punches IN PLACE: both feet stay planted on exactly the same pixels in every frame (only the back heel may lift 1 pixel at impact).
The head stays upright at the same height in every frame; it moves forward at most 2 pixels at the moment of impact.
The punching arm is the REAR arm (the arm on the far/left side of the body in frame 1, farther from the viewer). The near/front hand moves up to guard the chin.
At full extension the punching arm is perfectly horizontal at visor height and a little longer than natural.
The pink scarf lags behind the body: it lifts during the wind-up, is pulled straight back at impact, drops while the arm retracts, and swings forward at the end.

frames.pose: load: hips sink 1 pixel, rear shoulder pulls back 1 pixel, rear fist cocked next to the chin; scarf tip lifts slightly
twist: torso starts turning forward, rear fist moves forward past the chin, front hand rises to guard the chin; head 1 pixel forward
fast: rear arm three quarters extended forward at visor height, the arm drawn slightly stretched to suggest speed; scarf trailing back

IMPACT: rear arm fully extended straight forward, horizontal, at visor height, fist at its farthest point; head 2 pixels forward, back heel lifted 1 pixel, front knee slightly more bent; scarf pulled straight back
hold the impact pose exactly (same as previous frame)
retract: rear fist pulled back halfway toward the chest; head 1 pixel forward; scarf dropping down
retract: rear fist back near the chin; scarf rippling
overshoot: back in the fighting stance but the torso leans 1 pixel further back than the original stance; scarf swinging forward
the original fighting stance, unchanged (loops to frame 1)
